lessons_control.note: pre_lessons is each hunter's own sum before it read researcher_us/LESSONS.md. edge_resolve.py ranks it against the same realised move as the key, which is the only thing that can tell the guidance file apart from a habit.

language_control.note: pre_local is each hunter's own sum after the ENGLISH pass and before the local pass. eu_resolve.py ranks it against the same realised move as the key, per market, and does not pool the UK (where the second pass varies source locality) with Germany and France (where it varies language).

note: Ranked on impact_sum: the hunters' signed per-finding sizes, added up, in points of spot. No call and no threshold -- cut wherever you like afterwards, which is what keeps the ranking question answerable at every k. `conviction` (abs of the key) is where the direction skill lives: over all events the sign is a coin flip, above the median conviction it is 74%. conviction_floor is a floor on emphasis in the note, never a filter on this file. Everything under `diagnostics` was measured as neutral or subtractive and decides nothing -- see researcher_us/EDGE_ANALYSIS.md.

hunter_view.bar: The forward pipeline inside the window is empty. No SEC filing of any kind since the 2026-09-02 10-Q and Item 2.02 8-K (https://data.sec.gov/submissions/CIK0001853921.json); Q3 results are due November; the only registered trial, STX-1150, has a primary completion of 2028-12-30 (https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT07428473); the next company appearance is the Cell & Gene Meeting on the Mesa on 2026-10-05 (https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/09/01/3354090/0/en/scribe-therapeutics-to-participate-in-upcoming-investor-conferences.html); there is no options market, so there is no skew to price an event against.
hunter_view.positioning_check: Short interest was 778,191 shares at the 08/31/2026 FINRA settlement, days to cover 2.63, up 173.3% from 284,711 shares at the 08/14/2026 settlement (https://api.nasdaq.com/api/quote/SCTX/short-interest?assetclass=stocks). FINRA settles twice monthly and publishes about eight business days later, so the position carried INTO the 2026-09-21 fall is not observable and the next settlement covering mid-September publishes around 2026-09-24, outside the window. Days to cover of 2.63 is not crowded enough to force a squeeze. Insiders show 11 open-market buys and 0 sells over both 3 and 12 months (https://api.nasdaq.com/api/company/SCTX/insider-trades). Float is the binding fact: approximately 17,577,400 shares were outstanding after the IPO and concurrent private placement (the 424B4 states 1% of shares outstanding equals approximately 175,774 shares), and substantially all non-IPO holders are locked up until 2027-01-19, leaving a tradeable float near the 8.6m IPO shares — which is why the 14-day ATR is 12.1%. There is no skew to read: the baseline records no_options_market.
hunter_view.baseline_tension: It agrees with the volume and with this name's own history — 2.75x is at the benign end of the base-rate table, where under 2x pays +1.46% against -2.44% above 15x, and both of this stock's prior comparable falls bounced (+1.77%, +1.57%, median +1.67%) — but it cuts hard against the free ranker, because a 14-day ATR of 12.1% is very high and high-ATR names keep falling (rho=-0.126, family-wise p=0.0017), and against the cross-sectional prior for its drop-size and turnover bands, which is -0.295%; so expected_move_pct is set at +1.8 against a findings sum of +2.9, a cut of 1.1 points.

findings.finding: The index demand that this stock ran up into is complete and dated — FTSE Russell's September quarterly IPO addition became effective at the open of 2026-09-21, so the 2026-09-22 session is the first with no index-related buying or front-running flow scheduled against it, and the pre-positioned sellers who drove the 15% intraday decline have no further index event to sell into.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: This stock has fallen at or below -10.5% twice since its 2026-07-24 listing — -11.47% on 2026-08-13 and -16.21% on 2026-08-25 — and rose the next close both times, +1.77% and +1.57%, median +1.67%, up-rate 100% on n=2 (sealed baseline history block).

findings.finding: No analyst cut can land in the window: all four covering analysts initiated on 2026-08-18 at Buy or Overweight with price targets of $37, $50 and $60 against a $28.05 close, none has changed a rating or a target since, and no analyst action accompanied the 2026-09-21 fall — so the 'estimate cuts have only started' pattern that drives most continuation does not apply to this name.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No analyst downgrade has ever landed on this stock — it has been public for two months and the only rating events on record are the 2026-08-18 initiations and a Zacks Research move to hold on 2026-09-01, neither of which coincided with either prior double-digit fall.

findings.finding: No dilution or supply mechanism can act in the window: the filing record contains zero mentions of 'at-the-market' ever, the company is not S-3 shelf-eligible until roughly July 2027, the IPO lock-up runs to 2027-01-19, and the 2026-09-02 release states $43.0m of cash at 30 June plus approximately $140.6m of net IPO and private-placement proceeds funds operations into the first half of 2029 — so the going-concern language that appeared in the pre-IPO S-1 and 424B4 has no route back into a filing.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: There is no history of a supply event on this stock: it has been listed for two months, has filed one S-8 for its own equity plans and no resale or shelf registration, and the sealed baseline's full-text probes return 0 hits ever for 'at-the-market', 'minimum bid price' and 'non-reliance'.

outside_window.finding: IPO lock-up expiry: all directors, officers and substantially all security holders are locked for 180 days from the 2026-07-23 prospectus date, releasing the great majority of approximately 17.58m shares outstanding against a tradeable float near 8.6m — the single largest dated supply event this name faces.
Next FINRA short-interest settlement publication, which will be the first observation of the position carried into and out of the 2026-09-21 fall.
CFO David Parrot's Innovation Spotlight presentation at the Cell & Gene Meeting on the Mesa, the company's next scheduled appearance.
STX-1150 Phase 1 primary completion — the lead asset's first-in-human readout, and the only registered trial.

hunter_view.bar: The company's own stated forward pipeline and supply stack: a Phase 2b/3 in CSU and a Phase 2 in food allergy to be initiated with no dates given, the complete Phase 2 data set including the PK and IgE analyses deferred to an unnamed 'upcoming scientific meeting', 12 months of runway from the July 2026 $50m private placement, and 4,090,908 resale-registered warrant shares against 7,264,414 shares outstanding. Sources: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1645460/000119312526396094/d21238d8k.htm (2026-09-21), https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1645460/000119312526352128/cue-20260630.htm (2026-08-14), https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1645460/000119312526255418/d103205ds3.htm (2026-06-03).
hunter_view.positioning_check: Short interest is small and shrinking, and it is stale: 318,420 shares at the 08/31/2026 FINRA settlement, 1.76 days to cover, -2.8% vs the 08/14/2026 settlement, against 7,264,414 shares outstanding as of 2026-08-12 - about 4.4% of shares out, and FINRA publishes about eight business days late so the position carried into the 2026-09-21 fall is not observable (https://api.nasdaq.com/api/quote/CUE/short-interest?assetclass=stocks; https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1645460/000119312526352128/cue-20260630.htm). There is no skew to read: the baseline records the chain as 'unusable_chain' with 425 total open interest and no two-sided ATM legs, so no straddle or 25-delta skew can be priced. Insider positioning is the opposite of the short book: CEO Shao-Lee Lin filed a Schedule 13D on 2026-08-21 reporting 467,166 shares, 6.2%, acquired with personal funds in the May 2026 offering at $11.00 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1645460/000172509226000015/primary_doc.xml), and Nasdaq's Form 4 summary shows 9 open-market buys against 4 sells in the last three months.
hunter_view.baseline_tension: It cuts both ways and the halves do not net to zero: the 22.5x volume spike (>15x band averages -2.44% next session) and the 15.4% ATR14 (the single free ranker that cleared a family-wise correction, and it says high-vol fallers keep falling) point harder down than my findings do, while this name's own eight comparable falls are a coin flip (50% up, median -0.42%, median absolute 6.45%) and three of my five findings are positive - so my emitted -2.5 sits between a -0.8 research read and a reaction function that is more bearish than the research, which is the one direction the brief lets the reaction function override in.

findings split 3 positive / 2 negative: the sum nets opposing theses rather than resolving them

findings.finding: 4,090,908 resale-registered, un-locked-up warrant shares - 56% of the 7,264,414 shares outstanding, struck at $0.001 and $11.00 - remain saleable into the 2026-09-22 session, and the 2026-09-21 unwind that turned roughly 3.0m shares (about 42% of shares outstanding, $99.8m against a $4.2m median) did not switch off at the close.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: This overhang has been live since 2026-06-17 and the stock still ran +50.5% over 20 days into the readout, so it does not sell continuously - it sells into liquidity. The two comparable falls that came after the May 2026 offering registered are 2026-08-17 (-19.18%, next close -7.02%) and 2026-04-21 (-21.18%, next close -13.43%), the two worst day-2 outcomes in this name's eight-event history.

findings.finding: The holder with the largest paper gain and the clearest motive to sell - Ascendant Health Sciences, which took 551,724 pre-funded warrant shares as license consideration at $0.001 and has had them resale-registered since 2026-07-01 - is contractually barred from selling into the 2026-09-22 session, because its Investor Agreement lock-up does not begin releasing until 180 days after the 2026-04-30 License Agreement.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior release has occurred - this is the first lock-up window in the agreement's life, so there is no reaction history on this line for this name and the finding is sized off the share count (551,724 shares, 7.6% of shares outstanding) rather than off a precedent.

findings.finding: The only sell-side action on the record after the fall is a defence, not a cut: B. Riley reiterated Buy with an $83 target on 2026-09-21, said it would accumulate into the 24% decline, and attributed the weakness to the missing PK and IgE data rather than to the result - so the estimate flow reaching the 2026-09-22 session carries no downgrade.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Coverage on this name is thin enough that one note is the whole flow; the baseline carries no prior estimate-revision event, so this is sized as the absence of the cascade of target cuts that normally follows a 24% drop rather than as a positive catalyst in its own right.

findings.finding: The commonest second shoe after a biotech data day - an overnight equity raise off the shelf - did not fire: EDGAR carries no 424B5, S-3 takedown, Form D or new 8-K from CIK 0001645460 after the 2026-09-21 08:00 ET data filing, checked at 2026-09-22, so there is no dated dilution trigger inside the window.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: This issuer has raised three times in five months - the May 2026 private placement ($27.6m net, closed 2026-05-04), the Ascendant license equity (2026-05-04) and the July 2026 private placement ($49.8m net, closed 2026-07-13) - and every one of them was a negotiated private placement announced by 8-K, not a same-night marketed follow-on, so the pattern that would have to repeat to hurt the window is one this issuer has not used.

findings.finding: The specific information gap that caused the fall will not be closed inside the window: the company committed only to presenting 'the complete data set including PK and IgE analyses from this 36-week study at an upcoming scientific meeting', naming no meeting and no date, so nothing arrives on 2026-09-22 to answer the objection the 08:00 ET call raised.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The nearest analogue in this name is 2025-12-19 (-21.64%, next close -5.22%) and 2026-04-21 (-21.18%, next close -13.43%), both falls where no clarifying document followed within a session; the two falls that bounced (+9.03% after 2026-01-15, +5.33% after 2025-04-01) are both smaller and on lower volume.

outside_window.finding: Ascendant's lock-up starts releasing: 25% of the Subject Securities can release automatically from roughly 2026-10-05 at the earliest if the close holds at or above $22.00 (100% above $11.00) for 10 of any 15 consecutive trading days after the Phase 2 Milestone announcement, and 50% releases on schedule 180 days after the 2026-04-30 License Agreement. 551,724 registered shares at a $0.001 strike, 7.6% of shares outstanding.

Ascendant's Top-Up Shares: on achievement of specified clinical and financial Top-Up Milestones the licensor is issued shares taking it to no less than 7.5% of Outstanding Capital Stock, with a $15.0m minimum value and no cap above it, and with pre-funded warrants substituted for any Excess Shares needing a Nasdaq 5635 vote. A positive Phase 2 readout is exactly the kind of clinical milestone this contemplates; it would surface as an 8-K Item 3.02 or, at the latest, in the Q3 10-Q.

The funded Phase 2b/3 CSU and Phase 2 food allergy programmes do not fit inside the stated runway: $17.4m of cash at 2026-06-30 plus $49.8m net July proceeds against a company statement of twelve months from 2026-08-14, with $36.8m of unused capacity left on the $80m Jefferies ATM Sales Agreement ($43.2m sold since inception) available without an 8-K.

No registered CUE clinical study has a primary completion date near the window - NCT06917885 completes 2027-01-31, NCT04852328 2027-10-31 and NCT07172256 2031-02 - so there is no dated binary readout to come from the trial register in this quarter.
